name: The Hunt for Nekrula, Part 1
description: Defeat Nekrula's bodyguard and find the secret passage leading to the final encounter.

objectives.description: Defeat Lord Karl Von Nekrula and his bodyguard.

specialRules.description: When the Arcane Circle is revealed, place a random Villain as Nekrula's Bodyguard on the Arcane Circle tile instead of drawing a Monster.
When the Secret Stairway is revealed, place Lord Karl Von Nekrula on the Secret Stairway tile instead of drawing a Monster.
Whenever a Hero explores and draws a new dungeon tile with a black arrow, place a random Item token on that tile.
Nekrula's Crypt tile is not used in this adventure.

introText: The Heroes hunt through the crypts for the passage to Nekrula's hidden resting place.
victoryText: Nekrula turns to mist and flees! You have defeated his bodyguard and wounded the vampire lord.
defeatText: Nekrula's power overwhelms you. The hunt ends in tragedy.
